name: Channeling Blast (Mythic)
body:
Your deity exerts its will through your destructive energy.

Prerequisite(s): Channeling Blast.

Benefit(s): You gain the mythic version of the channeling feat you selected for the non-mythic Channeling Blast, or you can choose another non-mythic channeling feat.
